Every machine, multiblock, Crate and Vault remembers who placed it.
# Modes
- **Public**: anyone can use it.
- **Trusted**: you and your trusted players.
- **Private**: only you.
Anyone else can't open, wrench, dismantle, break it or paste settings onto it. Conduits, hoppers and other automation always work, whatever the mode.

# Security Terminal
Use any Security Terminal to edit your own profile: your default mode and your trusted players. Changes apply to all your machines instantly, at any distance.
# Per machine
Each machine has a Security tab. Leave it on your profile's default, or set Public, Trusted or Private for that one machine. Only the owner can change it.
